headline: DexCom (DXCM) Could Be 12% Undervalued Following Its Rebound
summary: DexCom (DXCM) has been back on radar after its recent share price move, with the stock closing at $74.85. Investors are weighing that price against the company’s current fundamentals and recent trading performance. See our latest analysis for DexCom. The recent 1 day share price return of 2.02% and 90 day share price return of 30.04% suggest momentum has been building for DexCom, even though the 1 year total shareholder return declined 16.23%.
